directive: Mobile-first does not mean tiny. Tactical grid spaces are logical; visual scale must make Titans, Gates, and bosses feel immense.
visualRules: Normal enemies must occupy visibly less physical volume than the deity.
Do not shrink Titans to fit the map; enlarge architecture and Gate landmarks.
deity attacks use larger arcs, shockwaves, dust, terrain reaction, and camera weight.
The tactical grid expresses decisions, not literal human-sized squares.
Gates are landmarks visible from major battlefield zones and large enough to justify deity travel.
